question: What is the small box formed where a row and a column meet in a spreadsheet?
explanation: The individual box where a column and row meet is known as a cell, which holds your data. [learn more](BMP123_U3_T2#BMP123_U3_T2_h1)

question: How does Excel label the vertical columns across the top of the worksheet?
explanation: Columns use alphabetical letters like A, B, and C, whereas rows use numerical digits. [learn more](BMP123_U3_T2#BMP123_U3_T2_h1)

question: Which keyboard key moves your cursor horizontally to the next cell on the right?
explanation: Pressing Tab shifts the active cell one step to the right, helping speed up horizontal data input. [learn more](BMP123_U3_T2#BMP123_U3_T2_h2)

question: What feature should you use to quickly copy a repeated value down an entire column?
explanation: Dragging the fill handle down a column quickly duplicates text, numbers, or formula patterns without manual retyping. [learn more](BMP123_U3_T2#BMP123_U3_T2_h2)

question: Why do rows of hash marks like ##### suddenly appear inside a spreadsheet cell?

options.A: The data file has been locked by a user
options.B: The formula contains a mathematical error
options.C: The column is too narrow to show the number
options.D: The computer has a serious virus infection

explanation: Hash marks indicate that the cell value is wider than the current column width allows. [learn more](BMP123_U3_T2#BMP123_U3_T2_h3)

question: What is the standard alignment for numerical values inside an Excel table?
explanation: Numbers are typically aligned to the right to keep decimal places and digit columns neatly stacked. [learn more](BMP123_U3_T2#BMP123_U3_T2_h3)

question: What symbol must every formula or function start with in Excel?
explanation: Excel requires an equals sign at the very beginning of a cell entry to recognize it as a mathematical calculation. [learn more](BMP123_U3_T2#BMP123_U3_T2_h4)

question: Which built-in function should you use to find the average of scores stored in cells B1 through B10?
explanation: The AVERAGE function calculates the mean of a selected cell range automatically. [learn more](BMP123_U3_T2#BMP123_U3_T2_h4)

question: What happens to spreadsheet rows that do not match your chosen criteria when you apply a filter?

options.A: They are permanently deleted from storage
options.B: They are moved to a separate worksheet
options.C: They are temporarily hidden from view
options.D: They are changed to red warning text

explanation: Filtering hides non-matching rows without deleting them, allowing you to reveal the full dataset at any time. [learn more](BMP123_U3_T2#BMP123_U3_T2_h5)

question: Which of the following tasks can you accomplish using the sort feature?

options.A: Hide unwanted rows from the screen
options.B: Change font styles across multiple sheets
options.C: Calculate the total sum of a column
options.D: Organize text alphabetically from A to Z

explanation: Sorting rearranges the display order of your rows based on text, numbers, or dates in selected columns. [learn more](BMP123_U3_T2#BMP123_U3_T2_h5)

question: Which chart type is best for displaying how a single total divides into percentage parts, such as a budget?
explanation: Pie charts illustrate proportions and parts of a single whole dataset effectively. [learn more](BMP123_U3_T2#BMP123_U3_T2_h6)

question: You need to display monthly malaria case trends over an entire year. Which chart type works best?
explanation: Line charts connect data points sequentially, making them the standard choice for tracking chronological trends over time. [learn more](BMP123_U3_T2#BMP123_U3_T2_h6)

question: What page setup feature ensures that column header labels repeat at the top of every printed page?
explanation: Setting repeat title rows keeps your column headers visible across multi-page printouts for easier reading. [learn more](BMP123_U3_T2#BMP123_U3_T2_h7)

question: Which of the following actions is NOT recommended when preparing a wide multi-column table for physical printing?

options.A: Adjusting column widths to prevent data cutoff
options.B: Checking the layout using the print preview tool
options.C: Switching the page layout to landscape orientation
options.D: Keeping the page layout in portrait orientation

explanation: Wide tables with many columns will get cut off horizontally in portrait orientation and usually require landscape mode. [learn more](BMP123_U3_T2#BMP123_U3_T2_h7)
